page_title: AUX 0-0 LIL | Auxerre v Lille 10/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alexsandro (Lille) was quite harsh and Gael Angoula didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+7' The corner is swung in but Lille can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

90+7' Mohamed Bayo (Lille) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball goes behind for a corner. Lille will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+5' A brilliant cross into the box finds Thomas Meunier (Lille), who directs his header to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes an astonishing save.
90+4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lille comes to nothing.

90+4' Angel Gomes (Lille) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lille.
90+2' Christophe Pelissier has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Theo Bair (Auxerre) replacing Gaetan Perrin.
90+2' Substitution. Hamed Junior Traore leaves the pitch and is replaced by Florian Aye (Auxerre).
90+1' Bafode Diakite (Lille) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Gael Angoula stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
90' We will have 9 min. of added time.
90' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
88' Here is a change. Lassine Sinayoko is going off and Christophe Pelissier gives the last tactical orders to Ado Onaiwu (Auxerre).
84' The manager makes a subsitution with Mohamed Bayo (Lille) coming on for Remy Cabella.
82' Lille take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

82' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lille will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
81' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.

80' That didn't go as planned! Remy Cabella (Lille) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Theo De Percin, who easily kept it out.
80' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lille comes to nothing.
79' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Lille force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
78' Bruno Genesio has decided to substitute Aissa Mandi and he is replaced by Thomas Meunier (Lille).
78' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Andre Gomes as he is replaced by Osame Sahraoui (Lille).
74' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
74' The corner is swung in but Lille can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
74' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Remy Cabella (Lille), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lille.
73' Auxerre have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

72' The ball rebounds outside of the penalty area and falls to the feet of Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre), who directs his shot to the bottom left corner, but the keeper is there to block the effort. The ball is out of play. Auxerre will have a chance to score from a corner.

72' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
68' The referee signals a substitution. Angel Gomes (Lille) is brought on as a substitute for Ayyoub Bouaddi.
68' Bruno Genesio has decided to make a change. Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) replaces Ismaily.
68' Lille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
68' Ismaily (Lille) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear. The referee points to the corner flag and Lille will take a corner.
67' Ismaily (Lille) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Lille force their opponents to concede a corner.
65' Substitution. Assane Diousse walks off the pitch and Han-Noah Massengo (Auxerre) comes on as a substitute.
64' Referee Gael Angoula sees the trip by Bafode Diakite (Lille) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
58' Theo De Percin anticipates the direction of the penalty by Jonathan David (Lille). He attempted to put the ball into the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper was there in time to deny him.
58' Jonathan David (Lille) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
56' Paul Joly (Auxerre) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and the referee shows him a deserved red card!
56' The Lille players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
56' There's a break in play and referee Gael Angoula must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Lille using VAR. This could be interesting!
55' PENALTY APPEAL by Lille, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
55' Andre Gomes (Lille) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.

55' Close! Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Auxerre will have a goal kick.
53' The Lille players are stunned as referee Gael Angoula changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
49' Celebrations by Lille are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.

48' Jubal Junior (Auxerre) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Gael Angoula blows his whistle for an infringement. PENALTY! One of the players from Lille is about to take a penalty kick.
46' Referee Gael Angoula blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Auxerre.
45+3' Now Auxerre have a corner. Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' The shots on goal statistics – 1:1.
41' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) takes the corner which is cleared.
40' The resulting set piece from Auxerre is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. Auxerre have a corner.
40' Auxerre can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The linesman points to the corner flag, Auxerre are going to take it.

39' Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) dribbles into space and finds himself in a shooting position, but his shot from the edge of the box is bravely blocked. The ball goes out of play and Auxerre have been awarded a corner kick.
39' Remy Cabella (Lille) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
37' Lille work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
36' Remy Cabella (Lille) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
35' Ismaily (Lille) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Gael Angoula blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
33' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball. Lille get a free kick.
32' Lille take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
31' Remy Cabella (Lille) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Lille get a corner.
29' Auxerre quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
28' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Auxerre will take a corner kick.
25' Paul Joly (Auxerre) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going low in the middle of the goal, but Lucas Chevalier has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
22' Paul Joly (Auxerre) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
21' Jonathan David (Lille) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
20' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) commits a foul during an attacking move.
19' Remy Cabella (Lille) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
15' Jonathan David (Lille) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
12' Benjamin Andre (Lille) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Gael Angoula had an easy-decision to make.
12' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
11' Benjamin Andre (Lille) trips an opposition player and Gael Angoula signals a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Auxerre.
10' Remy Cabella (Lille) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

9' Benjamin Andre (Lille) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom right corner. Theo De Percin has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lille.

8' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
5' Neat passing move from Lille in order to create new attacking opportunities.

Lille will kick the game off.
Gael Angoula will officiate today.
